<div class="card-body">
'''Djas Puhr''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ディジャス・ピュア</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ダークサイドのフォース・アイコンが1つあるごとに、戦闘力＋1となる。「夜間状態」では、戦闘力＋2。耐：損耗＜3。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-171o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">サキヤンの男性。この種族は、しばしば暗殺者やバウンティ・ハンターとして雇われる。赤外線視力、超広角視力を持ち、優れた聴力嗅覚の持ち主である。臭いで追跡ができる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Djas Puhr.

'''Card text:''' Power +1 for each Dark Side Force icon present. Power +2 under nighttime conditions. Immune to attrition < 3.

'''Lore:''' A male Sakiyan. The species is often hired as assassins or bounty hunters. Infrared and ultra-wide vision, with excellent hearing and smell. Can track by scent.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Djas Puhr]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
